item.subject: Planned maintenance next month
item.text: Hello, we will run planned maintenance on our results endpoint on the first Saturday of next month between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. The endpoint will be unavailable during that time. No action is needed now, and we will confirm the date again a week before. Thanks, Results Partner IT
